blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Some state universities and colleges (SUCs) are moving to complete infrastructure projects worth more than P5 million on their own, instead of letting the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) handle them, according to Pinoy Workers party-list Rep. Karl Josef Legazpi on Wednesday. During the House sponsorship and plenary deliberations on the proposed SUC budget for next year, Kabataan party-list Rep. Renee Co raised concerns about delayed completion of infrastructure projects at several SUCs, citing the University of the Philippines-Diliman faculty center and the north academic building at the Polytechnic University of the Philippines-Sta. Mesa as examples. […]... Keep on reading: Some SUCs handling infra projects worth over P5M on their own — solon
